fees_note: Google Play listing: 0.05% per day (≈1.5% per 30 days), maximum APR 18%, loans ₦10,000–₦500,000, tenor 91–365 days. Single advertised rate, not a range. FCCPC approvals table row 23 (Commercemen Trading Co. Ltd).

Site states interest range 21%–36% (per loan), 'Equivalent Monthly Interest: 2.8% – 19%', 'Equivalent APR: 34% – 272%'; late/rollover fees apply on some loans; borrower pays bank transaction fees. FCCPC approvals table row 29.

Site states max APR 195% per annum; late fee 0.03333% per day. Site example: ₦1,000,000 for 12 months at 4.5% monthly, total payable ₦1,540,000 (i.e. flat interest on the full amount). Operated by Carbon Microfinance Bank. FCCPC approvals table row 132 (Carbon Microfinance Bank).

Site says 'From 3.99%/mo'; no maximum stated, rate 'based on credit assessment'. Calculator illustrates 5%/month. Working capital tenor 1–6 months (new customers up to 6 months). FCCPC approvals table row 132 (Carbon Microfinance Bank).

Reported by Legit.ng on 26 Apr 2026. Article: 'Typically 5% to 10% monthly'. Lender's own FAQ (easemoni.com/faq) gives no standard rate but states late repayments incur 'rollover interest of 1% per day'. On FCCPC page only in CBN-licensed waiver table, not the main approvals table (OPay Microfinance Bank).

Site: 'Our APRs range from 24% to 456%'; monthly = APR / 12. Google Play representative example: ₦100,000 over 3 months, total interest ₦30,000, total payable ₦130,000, representative APR 120% (10% a month, flat). Earlier reports: Legit.ng 26 Apr 2026 and TechCabal 20 Nov 2025 reported 2.5–30% monthly. Operated by FairMoney Microfinance Bank. FCCPC approvals table row 59 (Fair Money Microfinance Bank).

Google Play listing: 2% per month (24% per annum), 'Payroll Loan Offer' example; tenor 3–84 months. Listing also gives APR 5.25–24%, but it is a multi-country app, so only the 2% a month headline is used here. FCCPC approvals table row 3 (Letshego Microfinance Bank Limited).

Reported by Legit.ng on 26 Apr 2026. Article: 'Charges between 3% and 15% monthly'. Lender site okash.ng unreachable (DNS error). On FCCPC page only in CBN-licensed waiver table, not the main approvals table (OPay Microfinance Bank).
